newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE-Japan trade soars to new peak in 1996, the Japan External Trade Organisation said.
- Gulf Air to cut 400 jobs as part of a cost-cutting exercise.
- Emirates airline's air freight division posted a 23 percent increase in tonnages uplifted in fiscal 1996-97.
- UAE trade delegation plans Armenia visit.
- Russians form the bulk of patients at the dental clinic in a Dubai city hospital.
- Etisalat, the UAE telecommunications company, posted 1.7 billion dirhams in profits in 1996.
